edges.reason: collectTradingFees is gated by the onlyAllowed modifier which checks msg.sender.
adjustPosition is gated by the onlyAllowed modifier checking msg.sender.
liquidatePosition is gated by toOnlyAllowed and onlyAllowed modifiers on msg.sender.
liquidateAllPositions is gated by toOnlyAllowed and onlyAllowed modifiers on msg.sender.
evenOut is gated by the onlyAllowed modifier checking msg.sender.
setReward is gated by onlyVaultManagers which relies on msg.sender.
setSwapFee is gated by onlyVaultManagers which relies on msg.sender.
setPublicSwap is gated by onlyVaultManagers which relies on msg.sender.
setTendBuffer is gated by onlyVaultManagers which relies on msg.sender.
migrateProvider is gated by the onlyAllowed modifier checking msg.sender.
adjustPosition passes now (block.timestamp) to lbp.updateWeightsGradually, creating timestamp dependency.
_swap uses now (block.timestamp) as the Uniswap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
liquidatePosition reads lbp balance and pool id to determine amounts.
adjustPosition interacts with the Balancer vault via bVault.joinPool/exitPool.
adjustPosition pulls and approves tokenA when rebalancing positions.
adjustPosition pulls and approves tokenB when rebalancing positions.
constructor invokes initialize during deployment.
cloneRebalancer calls initialize on the freshly created clone.
initialize calls _setProviders to configure providers and tokens.
initialize creates the LBP and stores it in the lbp state variable.
initialize sets the reward token and grants router approval.
collectTradingFees transfers realized gains to providers via token transfer.
collectTradingFees exits pool via _exitPool to free profit tokens.
adjustPosition calls tokenA/tokenB transferFrom to pull provider funds.
adjustPosition exits the entire pool position before re-joining.
adjustPosition re-enters the pool via bVault.joinPool.
adjustPosition updates pool weights through lbp.updateWeightsGradually.
liquidatePosition exits part of the pool to free the requested token.
liquidatePosition transfers the liquidated amount to the recipient.
liquidateAllPositions exits the entire pool position.
liquidateAllPositions transfers the full token balance to recipient.
evenOut swaps the surplus token through the internal _swap helper.
_swap invokes uniswap.swapExactTokensForTokens on the router.
_exitPool calls bVault.exitPool with the constructed request.
sellRewards swaps reward tokens for each provider token via _swap.
shouldTend performs 1e18 scaled weight and slippage multiplications/divisions that can overflow or round.
Uniswap swap hands control to external pair/token contracts before evenOut completes, with no reentrancy guard.
Swap inside sellRewards makes external calls to the router/tokens before reward distribution finishes.
bVault.exitPool is an external call made before liquidatePosition reads balances and transfers.
bVault.joinPool external call occurs before adjustPosition's accounting is finalized, allowing reentrancy.
bVault.exitPool external call occurs before adjustPosition completes state updates.
ERC20 transfer to an arbitrary recipient can re-enter liquidateAllPositions before completion.
ERC20 transfer to an arbitrary recipient can re-enter liquidatePosition before completion.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is the recipient address parameter used directly by liquidatePosition when transferring tokens.
_amountNeeded is the amount parameter controlling how much liquidatePosition exits and transfers.
_token selects the pool index and is the token liquidatePosition transfers out.
_userData is the encoded request parameter _exitPool forwards to bVault.exitPool.
amountsOut is the local array of requested output amounts consumed by the bVault.exitPool call.
newWeights is the local target weights array written into lbp.updateWeightsGradually.
amount is the local value passed as the input amount to the internal _swap helper.
slippage is a local value computed and compared inside shouldTend against the swap fee.
